_comment: UK English strings. No gambling vocabulary anywhere — use stake/commitment/pledge/forfeit.

Common.openInWorldApp: Bue DoomTax wɔ World App mu
Common.onYourPhone: Ɛwɔ wo phone no so dada?

AuthButton.step1: Gye World App — app a ɛhia sika biara nni ho, sɛ adeɛ foforɔ biara.
AuthButton.step2: Bue World App na keka QR scanner a ɛwɔ main tab no so, na fa to code yi so.
AuthButton.step3: DoomTax bue wɔ World App mu. Keka Connect — ɛsaina ɔfeɛ koro bi sɛ ɛyɛ wo. Wonnhyɛ charge biara, biribiara nsenkyerɛ. DoomTax hyɛ wo session account no ase atomatiki — biribi foforɔ nni hɔ a wohia afa bom.
AuthButton.step4: Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ Hedera nhyehyɛe hwɛ so — bɔhyɛdeɛ no wɔ sika titiriw biara nni ho nnɛ.

StakeForm.description: Kyerɛw no sɛ bɔhyɛ a wohyɛ wo ho. Wo AI kokyerɛkyerɛni taa kyerɛw nsɛm yi ara bere a ɔhwɛ wo adansɛɛ — yɛ nokwafo dɛ nkɔ so sɛ atɔ hɔ no bɛyɛ hann.
StakeForm.placeholderIntention: Wie settlement agent no na yɛ payment koro ano afi akyi akɔ anim
StakeForm.tooShort: Ka kakra bio fa adwuma no ho.
StakeForm.qualityHint: Dwennimdie pa yɛ adwene a wohu: din adwuma no na da bɛn a ɛyɛ wie.
StakeForm.sessionInfo: Wo {stake} ℏ no kura wɔ Hedera nhyehyɛe hwɛ mu ma {duration}. Siesie bɔhyɛ no na ɛsane bio nyinaa. Sɛ wontiesie a, ɛkɔ ɔkwan a yɛdi ho no so, ɛmma yɛn da. Wobɛtumi atu session no asie bere biara ansa-na esiesie.
StakeForm.exampleChip1: Kyerɛw nsɛm 300 a ɛfa report no ho
StakeForm.exampleChip2: Yi inbox no hɔ kɔ zero

ArtifactForm.heading: Kyerɛ wo adwuma
ArtifactForm.placeholderArtifact: Paste adwuma a wosiiiɛ, anaasɛ kyerɛw nea wowiee ne baabi a ɛwɔ.
ArtifactForm.coachReceivesIntention: Wo dwennimdie ne nsɛm a ɛwɔ soro
ArtifactForm.coachNeverReceivesAttachment: Wo attachment — ɛmfi phone yi mu da (nnɛ)
ArtifactForm.coachPrivacy: Ɛnyɛ wo screen, wo browsing, wo keyboard, anaasɛ biribiara a ɛfiri app foforɔ mu da.
ArtifactForm.coachReadingBody: Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ 0G so, na siesie wɔ Hedera so. Ɛbɛtumi akɔ kakra.
ArtifactForm.attachButton: Fa wo adwuma foto bom — sɛ wo pɛ
ArtifactForm.attachCaption: Ɛtena wo device no so. Wɔyɛ fingerprint (hash) wɔ hɔ ara sɛ version a ɛba akyiri bɛtumi ayɛ verify wɔ chain so. OCR wɔ 0G so ba — nnɛ kokyerɛkyerɛni hwɛ wo text nko ara.

Verdict.settledOnHedera: Asiesie wɔ Hedera nhyehyɛe hwɛ so
Verdict.publicReceiptDetail: Ɛwɔ bɔhyɛ hash ne atɔhɔ no nko. Wo dwennimdie anaasɛ adwuma no nni hɔ da.

ConfirmSheet.title: Tu session yi aseɛ?
ConfirmSheet.body: Wo <amount>{stake} ℏ</amount> no san bɛba wo nkyɛn nyinaa na biribiara nkɔ. Session no wie nnɛ ara na wɔammɛma wo kokyerɛkyerɛni nhunu. Fa yi di dwuma bere a ɔkwan foforɔ di, na ɛnyɛ asɛnka.
ConfirmSheet.confirm: Tu aseɛ na fa bɔhyɛdeɛ no bɛma me

CirclePanel.impactDetail: {count} a wonntiesie no aboa ɔkwan yi. Leaderboard nni, obiara dodow nni, na wonkyerɛ da hwan ntiesie.
CirclePanel.pendingForfeit: Sɛ session yi gyina a, <amount>{stake} HBAR</amount> bɛkɔ wo sɛntanmu dodow mu appeal bere akyi. Adeɛpa no di ho, na wo din nkɔ ne ho.
CirclePanel.private: Wo sɛntanmu tena hɔ a ɛyɛ akyinnyegyeɛ. Yɛkyerɛ nea mudi ho baabiara, na ɛnyɛ member list — na wonkyerɛ da hwan ntiesie.

About.heroTitle: Ɔkwan pa a ɛfa so de dwennimdie akɔ adwuma
About.heroBody: DoomTax yɛ adwuma ahyɛdeɛ a ɛgyina bɔhyɛ-adeɛ nhwehwɛmu a ɛfiri suansua ɔsesɛm so. Wo din adwuma koro, fa bɔhyɛdeɛ ketewa si akyi, na gye atɔhɔ trenea wɔ awieɛ.
About.gettingInBody: DoomTax yɛ app ketewa wɔ World App mu. Fa QR code a ɛwɔ aseɛ bue wɔ wo phone so.
About.readyBody: Hyɛ aseɛ wɔ bɔhyɛdeɛ ketewa bi. Nhwehwɛmu kyerɛ sɛ ɛtaa sen bɔhyɛ no yɛ nokwareɛ — yi biribi a wopɛ wie wɔ session a ɛba akyiri.
